points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Exact b962bf5 curated source clean CMake build succeeds in restricted network-disabled cfd-bench container; selected results report earlier revision bf6e816.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: b962bf5 main.cpp:38–74 parses solve, case, output, restart, flux and control options; bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:210–226 writes per-rank restart state/history; exact restart continuation not rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: b962bf5 solver/src separates CGNS import, global/local mesh, case input, finite-volume solver, physics and output; plotting/report tooling resides under solver/tools.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected submitted solver/source and build wiring; no internal existing CFD executable invocation found. No external authorship search performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:43–74 reads case and configurable flux/control options, cgns_reader/global_mesh handle supplied geometry; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root-only global mesh is released before solver, with METIS and neighbor halo; selected Re20 np4/np8 Cl means +0.012703 vs −0.389676 and Cd 0.91697 vs 0.84691. Selected root session confirms the same flux/CFL/max-step controls and no restart as np8.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: bf6e816 solver guards nonfinite/positivity and reports failures, but all steady inner targets miss and Re20 selected rank-sensitive Cl differs 0.402; final source changes limiter and plateau logic.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Curated solver/tools contains test_freestream.cpp, test_lusgs.cpp and test_residual.cpp; selected rank study exposes material Re20 lift sensitivity. No new CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source/report separated; original raw histories are workspace evidence absent from curated tip. Metadata pins bf6e816 whereas final fv_solver.cpp differs.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: physics.hpp implements calorically perfect gas conservative variables, Roe/Rusanov and Newtonian-Fourier flux. Thermal gradient indexing defect recorded separately.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:81–84,151–168 imports CGNS and partitions on root, scatters local mesh and frees global before run; selected metadata gives 8-rank ownership/ghosts.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:365–395 reconstructs and assembles Riemann face flux, :397–447 adds directional-corrected viscous flux; temperature gradient uses wrong primitive slot.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: physics.hpp:58–133 implements Rusanov and Roe Harten entropy fix; manifest uses Roe for M080 inviscid and Re200, Rusanov for other production cases.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: physics.hpp:153 onwards implements farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic ghosts; fv_solver.cpp:694–725 outputs no-slip zero velocity and projected tangential friction.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:229–283 computes and exchanges Green–Gauss primitive gradients and :343–389 reconstructs faces with positivity fallback. Frozen per-inner coefficients and steady limiter freeze are disclosed.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:283 onward computes single Barth–Jespersen coefficient; :1049–1085 can freeze it on steady chatter, disclosed in report.tex:180–187,770–775.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Production bf6e816 and final b962bf5 fv_solver.cpp:229–255,421–437 read pressure gradient for temperature slot via grad_off(1+q); correction replaces along-connecting-direction component but generally retains wrong transverse component. :449–462 and :718–725 project tangential shear; no-slip surface velocity is zero.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Production bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:1049–1094 uses SGS with lagged gradients/limiter; selected steady metadata records every inner target missed, but separate outer target and force plateau govern convergence.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:893–926 refreshes gradients/limiter once per physical step and tests frozen-coefficient residual; zero reported misses do not prove fully refreshed nonlinear target. St≈0.11281 for t>=105 but ≈0.075 peak for t>=100.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Same revision bf6e816 and matching step-0 Re20 force rows, but settled np4/8 Cl differs by 0.40238 and Cd by 0.07007; Selected root session confirms matching np4 controls and fresh start; DQ4 applies. Numerical rank sensitivity material.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Selected eight workspace case packages and report previously passed examiner validator; their metadata identifies bf6e816. Validator pass does not establish physics or fully refreshed inner convergence.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit eight-case/report validator was previously run and passed; current cfdeval gates verify manager artifacts only, not convergence or accuracy.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady statuses show outer residual/force plateau but all inner target fractions 0; Re200 reaches t300.01 and reports frozen-coefficient target success, not confirmed refreshed nonlinear residual.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Selected Re20 Cd0.8469/Cl-0.3897 is inaccurate/asymmetric despite stable forces; Re200 Cd mean1.126 and Cl rms0.0266 but dominant FFT frequency shifts with time window.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Seven immutable steady force plots collapse at physical_time=0, and Re200 full-history Cd startup hides late drag; separate lift plot has no drag. Report includes readable residual and contour assets.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report accurately discloses Re20 asymmetric result and rank sensitivity, and includes diagnostics; it calls all steady force histories readable although figures collapse at time zero.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Metadata identifies bf6e816 for selected results while final b962bf5 fv_solver.cpp differs; report includes tables/manifests but selected root session records matching np4 CLI controls.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Exact b962bf5 clean build succeeds in restricted container; main.cpp:38–74 supports documented CLI/restart and bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:210–226 writes state/history. No restart rerun.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: Root reads CGNS and constructs METIS partition; main.cpp:151–168 scatters local mesh and releases global before iterations. Selected Re20 exhibits unresolved rank sensitivity.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:365–447 implements FV face Rusanov/Roe and directional corrected viscous flux with ghost BCs; thermal gradient indexing defect noted under viscous.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:229–283,343–389 uses Green–Gauss reconstructed states and limiter with positivity fallback; steady limiter freezing and transient lagged coefficients are disclosed.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: bf6e816 and b962bf5 fv_solver.cpp:229–255 store gradients in rho,u,v,p,T order, but :421–437 uses grad_off(1+q) for u,v,T, so T takes pressure gradient index3 instead of T index4. Directional correction restores only projected component; tangential shear force and no-slip boundary outputs are implemented.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:893–926 evaluates transient inner ratios using gradients/limiter frozen at start of physical step; selected metadata reports zero misses but does not establish fully refreshed nonlinear residual. All selected steady metadata report 100% inner target misses (Re20 794/794, M015 inviscid 1034/1034). BDF2 and implicit SGS are implemented; final source differs.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only global mesh is released before solve (main.cpp:81–84,151–168); METIS/halo and reductions exist. Re20 selected np4/np8 Cl tail means +0.012703/−0.389676 differ by 0.40238, Cd 0.91697/0.84691 differ 7.6%. Both metadata name bf6e816 and step-0 forces match roundoff, and selected root-session 2026-08-29T22:43:17.883Z confirms same flux/CFL/max-step controls and no restart as np8 manifest. Absolute Cl difference 0.40238 is order-one relative to drag scale; DQ4 applies.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Selected Re20 settled Cd0.8469 and Cl-0.3897, physically inaccurate for symmetric cylinder; report discloses. Re200 St0.11281 for t>=105 but dominant raw FFT peak changes to ≈0.075 for t>=100. All steady force plots are unreadable at t=0; raw case values survive.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report supplies detailed numeric tables, residuals and contours and candidly discusses Re20; seven steady force figures collapse at time zero, Re200 late Cd unreadable. Source/report provenance differs bf6e816 vs final b962bf5.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: src separates mesh, physics, case, solver and output, and CLI reads configurable case/flux; general 3-D/RANS extensibility not demonstrated.

flags.flag: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
flags.evidence: Original Re20 np4 and np8 packages both name bf6e816, converge with tight last-20 tails, and start with Cd=156.95244366, Cl≈1e-10 matching to roundoff. Selected root session at 2026-08-29T22:43:17.883Z launches np4 via scripts/run_case.sh with --flux rusanov --cfl-initial 5 --cfl-max 10 --max-steps 12000, no restart, matching immutable run_manifest np8 controls. Last-20 mean Cl is +0.0127033235 vs -0.3896761175: absolute coefficient difference 0.40237944 (~44% of np4 Cd scale), an order-one force-vector change; Cd 0.91697169 vs 0.84690655 differs 7.6%. Near-zero lift ratio alone is not used as criterion. Report.tex:737–756 discloses rank sensitivity.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars.

Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
